patches.failure: Android loader/runtime compatibility risk for native executables.
patches.semantics: No non-Android behavior change; Android binaries contain an aligned .tdata item.
patches.removal_condition: OpenAI or the Rust/linker toolchain guarantees and tests the required Android TLS alignment.

patches.purpose: Use a trusted native Termux protoc because protoc-bin-vendored has no Android/aarch64 binary.
patches.failure: code-mode-protocol build cannot locate a vendored protoc for Android/aarch64.
patches.semantics: PROTOC override wins; Android uses PATH protoc; desktop retains vendored protoc.
patches.removal_condition: Upstream provides an Android protoc strategy or no longer builds protobufs on the Android target.

patches.purpose: Avoid eagerly evaluating the unsupported vendored protoc fallback on Android.
patches.failure: unwrap_or eagerly calls protoc_bin_path even when the Android PATH protoc was selected.
patches.semantics: Only the selected protoc provider is evaluated.
patches.removal_condition: The upstream selection is lazy and works on Android/aarch64.

patches.purpose: Preserve exclusive app-server startup coordination on Android.
patches.failure: failed to initialize in-process app-server client: lock() not supported
patches.semantics: Blocking advisory exclusion, EINTR retry, release on descriptor close; non-Unix unchanged.
patches.removal_condition: Rust std File::lock works on Android or upstream supplies equivalent tested coordination.

patches.purpose: Preserve cross-process installation-ID initialization on Android.
patches.failure: installation ID initialization fails with lock() not supported
patches.semantics: Blocking advisory exclusion, EINTR retry and release on descriptor close; non-Unix unchanged.
patches.removal_condition: Rust std File::lock works on Android or upstream supplies equivalent tested coordination.

patches.purpose: Preserve thread-store writer coordination and nonblocking conflict detection on Android.
patches.failure: persistent session creation/resume fails because lock and try_lock are unsupported
patches.semantics: Blocking coordination plus LOCK_NB conflicts mapped to TryLockError::WouldBlock; non-Unix unchanged.
patches.removal_condition: Rust std locks work on Android or upstream supplies equivalent tested writer coordination.
